T01: by intro m N M; unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ; grind
T02: by intro m N M; unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ; grind
Q01:
by
  intro a b c x ha hd
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (2 * a * x + b) ^ 2 := Int.sq_nonneg _
  have h2 : 0 ≤ a * (4 * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c)) := by
    have e : a * (4 * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c)) = (2 * a * x + b) ^ 2 + (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) := by grind
    rw [e]; grind
  have h3 : 0 ≤ 4 * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) := Int.nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h2 ha
  grind
T03:
by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T01 m N M]
  have a1 : m.trJ * M < 0 := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h1 h4
  have a2 : 0 ≤ (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := Int.mul_nonneg (by grind) h5
  grind
T04:
by
  intro m N M h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T02 m N M] at h5
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hS
  have hS' : m.S ≤ 0 := by grind
  have b1 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by grind) (by grind)) (Int.sq_nonneg N)
  have b2 : 0 ≤ (-m.S) * N * M := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by grind) h4) (by grind)
  have b3 : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos h0 (by have := Int.mul_pos h3 h3; grind)
  grind
T05:
by
  intro m N M h0 h1 h2 h3 h4
  rw [T02 m N M]
  have b1 : 0 ≤ N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M) := Int.mul_nonneg h2 (by grind)
  have b3 : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos h0 (by have := Int.mul_pos h1 h1; grind)
  grind
T06:
by
  intro m N M h0 h1 h2 h3 h4
  rw [T02 m N M] at h4
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
  have hc' : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M := by grind
  have b1 : 0 ≤ N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M) := Int.mul_nonneg h2 hc'
  have b3 : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos h0 (by have := Int.mul_pos h1 h1; grind)
  grind
T07:
by
  intro m p s h0 hp hDD hS n hn
  have hM : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by unfold Scope.modeM; have := Int.mul_pos hp hp; grind
  have hn2 : (1 : Int) ≤ (n : Int) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : (1 : Int) ≤ (n : Int) := by grind
    have := Int.mul_le_mul h1 h1 (by grind) (by grind)
    grind
  have hs : 0 ≤ s ^ 2 := Int.sq_nonneg s
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) hs
  have hge : s ^ 2 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    have := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn2 hs
    grind
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hneg
  have hlt : m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0 := by grind
  have k := T06 m (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) h0 hM hN hDD hlt
  have e1 : m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * Scope.modeN s n := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hge hDD
  unfold Scope.modeM at k
  grind
T08:
by
  intro m N M h0 h1
  rw [T02 m N M]
  have := Q01 (m.Du * m.Dv) (-(m.S * M)) (m.detJ * M ^ 2) N h0 (by
    have : (m.S * M) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * (m.detJ * M ^ 2) := by
      have : (m.S ^ 2) * M ^ 2 ≤ (4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ) * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Int.sq_nonneg M)
      grind
    grind)
  grind
H01: by intro r₁ r₂ B C h hB; unfold Scope.hamGain; have := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hB; grind
H02: by intro r B C; unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain; grind
H03: by intro r₁ r₂ B C h hB hf; have := H01 r₁ r₂ B C h hB; unfold Scope.Favoured at *; grind
H04: by intro r B C₁ C₂ h hf; unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain at *; grind
D01: by intro V C hV; unfold Scope.hdDD Scope.hdHD; grind
D02: by intro V C; unfold Scope.hdHH Scope.hdDH; grind
T09:
by
  intro m N M h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  refine ⟨T04 m N M h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5, ?_⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
  have hc' : m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ := by grind
  have hDD : 0 < m.Du * m.Dv := Int.mul_pos h1 h2
  have := T08 m N M hDD hc'
  grind
T10:
by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4
  rw [T02 m N M] at h4
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
  have hc' : m.S * N ≤ m.detJ * M := by grind
  have b1 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg h3 (Int.sq_nonneg N)
  have b2 : m.S * N * M ≤ m.detJ * M * M := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc' (by grind)
  grind
T11:
by
  intro m p s h0 hp hDD ⟨n, hn, hneg⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
  have hc' : m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 := by grind
  have := T07 m p s h0 hp hDD hc' n hn
  grind
T12:
by
  intro m N M ht h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  unfold Scope.Hurwitz
  exact ⟨T03 m N M ht h1 h2 h3 h4, T05 m N M h0 h3 h4 h5 (Int.le_of_lt (Int.mul_pos h1 h2))⟩
